skill_name: Give advice to a friend who is confused about their career direction.
workflow: I understand your confusion about your career direction. It's important to take some time to consider what you really value in life and a job. Are you looking for interesting projects, more responsibility or something else? Once you have identified what matters the most to you, it will be easier to narrow the range of opportunities that align with your personal values.
